title: shipped 9 prs
summary: mostly plumbing and frontend speed runs (lazy-loading markdown, chunk splitting). fixed some streaming edge cases. also three new apps hit the showcase, including an ai city diorama generator and an mcp server. code is open

highlights.title: Frontend speed boost
highlights.text: We added lazy-loading and aggressive caching to the [main site](https://hello.pollinations.ai). Return visits now render near-instantly, because waiting for DOM elements is boring.

highlights.title: PromptPilot MCP Server
highlights.text: You can now generate images, video, and audio directly inside Claude, Cursor, or any other MCP-compatible agent.

highlights.title: AI City Diorama Generator
highlights.text: New in the showcase: a fully automated n8n pipeline that hallucinates cinematic miniature cities and publishes them straight to YouTube Shorts. [Try it](https://www.youtube.com/@WhatIF-KA/shorts)

highlights.title: LoreLoom Storybooks
highlights.text: Also new in the community showcase: an interactive, narrated AI storybook generator for kids. [Try it](https://loreloom.sprinthon.com)
